title: RBAC v2 integrity guardrails, phased migration runbook, and customer transition scripts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Runbook and guardrails for migrating customers from RBAC v1 to RBAC v2. Covers dual-write architecture, incremental backfills, SSO/SAML attribute reconciliation, audit-log continuity, admin control parity checks, and customer communication scripts. Goal: zero-privilege regressions, preserved audit trails, and a predictable, reversible cutover path.
migration_steps: Phase 0: Pre-migration validations - inventory roles, map unsupported constructs, baseline audit retention and query coverage
Phase 1: Dual-write enablement on a single tenant - enable v2 writes in parallel with v1 for a canary tenant and validate event parity for 48h
Phase 2: Incremental backfill - run read-only backfill jobs for audit history and role assignments in 1000-tenant batches with checksum verification
Phase 3: Snapshot verification - compute weekly role-state snapshots and diff against v1 authoritative state; require <0.01% divergence
Phase 4: Scoped cutover - switch authentication path for low-risk tenants (internal/dev) to read from v2 while continuing v1 writes for 72h
Phase 5: Observability ramp - enable detailed tracing, token-level latency histograms, and anomaly alerts on authorization failures
Phase 6: Customer opt-in wave - invite customers to opt into v2 via console toggle and run a final consistency check before full cutover
Phase 7: Global cutover and v1 deprecation - after meeting SLOs and parity thresholds, flip write traffic to v2 and schedule v1 shutdown window
rollback_plan: Pre-cutover: Toggle off v2 dual-write at API gateway and resume exclusive v1 writes
During cutover: If customer-facing errors > 0.5% or key admin flows fail for > 5 minutes, immediately revert routing to v1-read/v1-write
Post-cutover: If audit trail gaps or SSO mapping failures detected for any customer, trigger urgent backfill of missing records and reopen v1 access for the impacted tenants
Operator runbook: clear step-by-step revert commands, logs to collect, and required on-call escalation path to Security and Product
test_plan: Unit: Validate role translation library with randomized role graphs (10k permutations)
Integration: End-to-end SAML login + role resolution test harness against staging IdPs (Okta, AzureAD, OneLogin)
Load: Dual-write throughput test at 5x projected peak token auth rate with KV cache warmed
Chaos: Introduce delayed v2 write propagation and ensure instrumentation flags inconsistencies for automated reopening of v1 reads
Canary: 48h canary with synthetic and live traffic and daily automated consistency report
observability_and_alerts: Parity metric: rolling 24h percent of authorizations matched between v1 and v2 (target >=99.99%)
Audit continuity: per-tenant last-seen-audit-sequence difference (alert if >100 events)
SSO mapping errors: rate of unmapped identity attributes (alert if >0.1% of logins)
Admin drift: number of admin users missing expected privileges after backfill (alert if >1 per 1k accounts)
communication_plan: Internal: Engineering weekly migration sync with Security, Support, and Solutions to review canary results and open risks
Customer: Template emails and console banners for each migration wave with opt-in/out instructions and rollback guarantees
Support: Playbook for Tier 1 with triage checklist, escalation matrix, and canned responses for common issues
Legal/Compliance: Data retention notice and audit-preservation statement for regulated customers prior to their cutover window
